Title: AI Services Personalizer will be retired on August 25, 2026

Body.Content:
On August 25, 2026 AI Services Personalizer will be retired. From now through August 25, 2026, you can continue to use your existing AI Services Personalizer resources. After August 25, 2026 the AI Services Personalizer will not be supported. 

After August 25, 2026 you'll no longer be able to use AI Services Personalizer with your applications. You’ll be able to continue using existing resources until the retirement date of August 25, 2026. 

Help and support 

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request. 

  1. For Issue type, select Technical. 

  1. For Subscription, select your subscription. 

  1. For Service, select My services, then select  Cognitive Services. 

  1. Select the Azure resource that you are creating a support request for. 

  1. For Summary, type a description of your issue. 

  1. For Problem type, select  Availability. 

  1. For problem subtype, select  Service Unavailable.
Body.Markdown:
On August 25, 2026 AI Services Personalizer will be retired. From now through August 25, 2026, you can continue to use your existing AI Services Personalizer resources. After August 25, 2026 the AI Services Personalizer will not be supported.

After August 25, 2026 you'll no longer be able to use AI Services Personalizer with your applications. You’ll be able to continue using existing resources until the retirement date of August 25, 2026.

Help and support

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A . If you have a support plan and you need technical help, create a support request .

For Issue type, select Technical .

For Subscription, select your subscription.

For Service, select My services, then select Cognitive Services .

Select the Azure resource that you are creating a support request for.

For Summary, type a description of your issue.

For Problem type, select Availability .

For problem subtype, select Service Unavailable .
